ShoeItem.title: ShoeItem
ShoeItem.description: A footwear SKU inventory record mapping product barcodes and SKU to a warehouse bin location.

sku.description: Footwear SKU code from the warehouse stock sheet.

binNumber.description: Warehouse bin location identifier (e.g., A-12, B-04-2).

modelName.description: Human-readable shoe model name or brand/title.

barcodes.description: Product barcode strings (UPC/EAN/Code128/QR) linked to this SKU.

quantity.description: Current stock unit count in this bin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when record was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when record was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/shoe_items/{itemId}.description: User-scoped footwear SKU, bin location, and linked product barcodes.
